title: ThemeLens theme
description: A ThemeLens theme. A theme is data only and cannot run code.

id.description: Stable identifier, also used as the file name.

description.description: One line shown under the name.

base.description: dark: backgrounds become the dark page colour. light: backgrounds become the light page colour. keep: lightness is left as the app drew it.

roles.description: Output colour for each role. Required for the dark and light bases, not allowed for keep.

panel.description: Secondary backgrounds: toolbars, cards, table stripes.

link.description: Interactive accent, usually blue in the source.

good.description: Status colour, usually green in the source.

warning.description: Status colour, usually yellow or orange in the source.

bad.description: Status colour, usually red in the source.

maxLuminance.description: Brightness limit: the largest WCAG relative luminance any pixel in the lens may have. 1 means no limit.

minTextContrast.description: Smallest contrast ratio against the page given to text-like colours.

maxChroma.description: Largest OKLab chroma. Leave out for no limit. 0 removes colour.

maxAreaContrast.description: Largest contrast ratio against the page that a large area may have before the area guard pulls it back to the page colour.

warmth.description: 0 leaves blue alone, 1 removes almost all of it.

keepBackground.description: How hard the area guard works. Defaults to strict for the dark and light bases and off for keep.
